Every tool but two runs entirely on the machine and the text never leaves it; the two server-backed ones (perplexity, cross-language paraphrase) disclose that they send text. stdio transport, .NET 10, MIT. abilities.name: Shinjuku Shielded MCP

en.name: Shinjuku Shielded MCP
en.description: Private x402 payments on Solana: shield USDC, pay x402 URLs from a self-custodied shielded balance (the chain does not show who paid), and unshield, under spend caps that only the user sets. Tor built in; no RPC, account or API key needed. Install: `npx -y shinjuku-shielded mcp --max-payment 50000 --max-session 200000`; stdio, runs locally on Node.js 22+. Env: `SHIELDED_WALLET_HOME` (folder with the encrypted wallet), `SHIELDED_WALLET_PASSPHRASE` (secret) or `--passphrase-file`. Shield and unshield proof tools run on Linux or WSL only. Official MCP Registry id `io.github.ShinjukuStaition/shinjuku-mcp`. Docs: https://github.com/ShinjukuStaition/shinjuku-shielded. Website: https://shinjukustaition.com.
